s37-ku-leediyo.text: I heard it on the radio.
alts: I have heard it on the radio.

s37-agamba-nti.text: He says that rain is coming.
alts: She says that rain is coming.
She says the rain is coming.

s37-bagamba-nti.text: They say that the new road is finished.
alts: People say the new road is finished.
They say the new road is complete.

s37-ssentebe.text: The chairperson speaks at the meeting.
alts: The chairman is speaking at the meeting.
The chairperson is speaking in the meeting.

s37-ndowooza-nti.text: I think that it is good.

s37-sikkiriza.text: I don’t agree. I think it isn’t good.
alts: I disagree. I think it’s not good.
I do not agree. I think that it is not good.

s-mkutano.text: There is a meeting tomorrow evening.

s-kiongozi.text: Our leader is a capable woman.
alts: Our leader is a skilful woman.

s-serikali.text: The government will build a new school.

s-uchaguzi.text: The election will be next year.

s-harambee.text: We are having a harambee for the hospital.
alts: We have a fundraiser for the hospital.

s-tunapendana.text: In our family we love each other.

s-gazeti.text: Dad reads the newspaper every morning.
alts: Father reads the newspaper every morning.
Dad is reading the newspaper every morning.

s-redio.text: I heard the news on the radio.

s-taarifa.text: The news is at eight in the evening.
alts: The news bulletin is at 8 pm.

s-tukio.text: The event happened in town yesterday.
alts: The incident happened in town yesterday.

s-nadhani.text: I think it will rain today.

s-kwa-maoni-yangu.text: In my opinion, school is very important.

s-sikubaliani.text: Sorry, I don’t agree with you.
alts: Excuse me, I disagree with you.
Sorry, I do not agree with you.

phrases: He says that rain is coming.
They say that the new road is finished.
I think that it is good.

options: Yes! They say that the new road is finished.
Once upon a time, one day…

u37s3l3.line: I think we should plant trees in the village. What is your opinion?
options: Have you heard it on the radio?
